title: On Sowing the north field before the rain
subtitle: 植物农业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 植物农业（人与自然·自然生态·植物与农业）
meta: 主题语境：植物农业（人与自然·自然生态·植物与农业）　|　核心词汇：sow　|　正文 364 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 sow 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1989 the keeper ① sowed the north field before the rain on the same day, and every traveller in the tower said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the keeper ② sows the north field before the rain before dawn without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ sow the north field before the rain at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ sowed the north field before the rain before — a line in the calendar for January 1983 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Sowing the north field before the rain on the same day, the keeper said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the clock at the far stair, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ sow the rumour up and down the street before dawn, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Sow the rumour up and down the street at once and never mention it again.

By 1996 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the calendar, and a new traveller from the next tower ⑧ sows the rumour up and down the street on the same day every year without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the stair, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ sowed the north field before the rain again when nobody else would.

⑩ To sow the north field before the rain, my mother said in 2001, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the tower remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the tower forgets, somebody sows the north field before the rain before dawn again and somebody must sow the north field before the rain on the same day all over again.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 sow 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1989 the keeper sowed the north field before the rain on the same day, and nobody in the tower forgot it.
Even now the keeper sows the north field before the rain before dawn whenever the tower asks.
Sowing the north field before the rain on the same day, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever sow the rumour up and down the street before dawn, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new traveller from the next tower sows the rumour up and down the street on the same day every year, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother sowed the north field before the rain again, and the tower remembered that half.
